items.title: Pete Barbutti interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 8, 2022
items.q: he would do this whole thing about Puccini’s genius

ctx.x: It’s so interesting because I never heard that before, but I could feel it coming which made it even funnier.

And then he would do this wonderful thing on opera, on “Madame Butterfly” he would do this whole thing about Puccini’s genius and how he would do this and how he explains about the ensign on the American ship who is in Japan and he fell in love with this Japanese girl, Madame Butterfly, and she fell in love with him and they lived together and she became pregnant and then they got orders that they had to ship out, and the ensign had this terrible, he was torn because he knew what would happen, you know a half…

It seems like eventually bands, established bands personalities start maybe to conflict and I’m wondering if in The Millionaires any of the other members started to resent the fact that you became in the spotlight?
